```{python}
import json
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import _lib as L

num = L.fmt
opis, dobor = L.metrics("opis_danych"), L.metrics("dobor_materialow")
czasy, m41, m42, m43 = (L.metrics(n) for n in ["tagowanie_czasy", "ocena_41", "ekstrakcja_42", "frekwencje_43"])
m5, m6, m7 = (L.metrics(n) for n in ["llm_5", "pule_6", "pseudoslowa_7"])
kand = L.csv("kandydaci.csv")
cfg = __import__("yaml").safe_load((L.ROOT / "config" / f"{L.NAME}.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
short = lambda m: str(m or "–").replace("claude-", "")
pct = lambda v: f"{100 * v:.1f}%" if isinstance(v, (int, float)) else "–"
plt.rcParams.update({"figure.dpi": 110, "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False, "font.size": 9})
INK, ACCENT, MUTED = "#2c3e50", "#18bc9c", "#b4bcc2"

def kv(d, headers=("Item", "Value"), sort=False):
    items = sorted(d.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]) if sort else d.items()
    L.table(items, list(headers), "lr")
```

Run **`{python} L.RUN_NAME`** of configuration **`{python} L.NAME`**. All numbers are read from
the files in `{python} f"wyniki/{L.NAME}/{L.RUN_NAME}/metryki/"` when the site is rendered; the raw files are shown on the
[Reproduce](reproduce.qmd#raw-metrics-files) page. Polish key names from the files are kept where they identify a
column or a setting.

## 1 · Corpus {#corpus}

### Selection of materials

```{python}
          "cel": "of which target subject"}
L.table([(labels.get(k, k), v) for k, v in dobor.items()], ["Stage of selection (whole ZPE catalogue)", "Materials"])
```

From the selected materials this run sampled `{python} num(opis.get("materialy_cel"))` target materials and
`{python} num(opis.get("materialy_kontrast"))` contrast materials (six contrast materials per target one), with the
seed from the configuration.

## 2 · Tagging and lemmatisation {#tagging}

### Benchmark on `{python} num(m41.get("n"))` forms

Each tool lemmatised the same forms in their sentence context. *Exact* means the whole base form equals the
reference; *components* means each word of the answer shares a lemma with the matching word of the reference, even
if the phrase as a whole was not rebuilt in the nominative.

```{python}
tools = m41.get("narzedzia", {})
strata = sorted({k.split("__")[1] for d in tools.values() for k in d if k.startswith("lemat_dokladny__")})
st_lab = {"rzadki termin": "rare terms", "wielowyrazowe": "multiword", "pozostale": "other"}
n_zpe = next((d.get("n_ref_redakcja_ZPE") for d in tools.values()), None)
rows = [(f"`{t}`", d.get("lemat_dokladny_wszystkie"), d.get("lemat_skladniki_wszystkie"),
         d.get("lemat_dokladny_ref_redakcja_ZPE"), d.get("lemat_dokladny_ref_tymczasowa"),
         *[d.get(f"lemat_dokladny__{s}") for s in strata]) for t, d in tools.items()]
rows.sort(key=lambda r: -(r[1] or 0))
L.table(rows, ["Tool", "Exact, all", "Components, all", f"Exact, ZPE reference (n = {n_zpe})", "Exact, provisional reference",
               *[f"Exact, {st_lab.get(s, s)}" for s in strata]])
```

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Share of forms whose base form equals the reference."
#| fig-alt: "Horizontal bar chart of exact-match lemmatisation accuracy by tool."
prod = __import__("yaml").safe_load((L.ROOT / "config" / f"{L.NAME}.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["narzedzia"]["tager_produkcyjny"]
order = sorted(tools, key=lambda t: tools[t].get("lemat_dokladny_wszystkie") or 0)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.2, 2.6))
vals = [tools[t].get("lemat_dokladny_wszystkie") or 0 for t in order]
bars = ax.barh(order, vals, color=[ACCENT if t == prod else INK for t in order])
ax.bar_label(bars, fmt="%.2f", padding=3)
ax.set_xlim(0, 1); ax.set_xlabel("exact match, all forms (production tagger highlighted)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```

::: {.callout-warning title="What the reference is"}
`{python} "The sheet has been checked by a human and the scores use those answers." if m41.get("referencja_ludzka_z_arkusza") else "The sheet has not been checked by a human yet."`
Until it is, the reference is the base form written by ZPE editors where one exists, and otherwise a provisional
answer from the adjudicating language model. The editors' forms were not written for this study (some keep the
plural, for example), and a reference written by a language model may favour the LLM lemmatisers. The sheet itself is on the
[Annotation worksheets](sheets.qmd) page.
:::

```{python}
L.md("Composition of the sample:")
src = {"redakcja ZPE": "ZPE editors", "tymczasowa": "provisional (LLM)"}
L.table([(st_lab.get(r["warstwa"], r["warstwa"]), src.get(r["zrodlo_referencji"], r["zrodlo_referencji"]), r["n"]) for r in m41.get("sklad", [])],
        ["Stratum", "Reference from", "Forms"], "llr")
if m41.get("uwaga"):
    L.md(f"Note saved with the metrics (PL): *{m41['uwaga']}*")
```

## 4 · Candidate extraction {#extraction}

```{python}
mian, pr = m42.get("mianowniki", {}), m42.get("progi", {})
L.table([("Subject candidates after the thresholds", m42.get("n_kandydatow")), ("… single-word", m42.get("n_jednowyrazowych")),
         ("… multiword", m42.get("n_mwu")),
         ("… found in one material only (kept because frequent there)", m42.get("n_kandydatow_z_jednego_materialu")),
         ("General candidates (source of T1/T2 items)", m42.get("n_kandydatow_ogolnych")),
         ("… not among the subject candidates", m42.get("n_kandydatow_ogolnych_tylko")),
         ("Lemmas dropped as proper names", m42.get("n_odrzuconych_nazw_wlasnych")),
         ("Terms returned by TermoPL", m42.get("termopl_terminow")),
         ("… linked to a candidate", m42.get("termopl_dopasowanych_kandydatow"))], ["Measure", "Value"])
```

A subject candidate needs at least `{python} num(pr.get("min_frekw_cel"))` occurrences in at least
`{python} num(pr.get("min_materialow"))` biology materials, or at least `{python} num(pr.get("min_frekw_jeden_material"))`
occurrences if it is found in a single material. A general candidate needs at least
`{python} num(pr.get("ogolne_min_frekw"))` occurrences in at least `{python} num(pr.get("ogolne_min_materialow"))`
materials of at least `{python} num(pr.get("ogolne_min_przedmiotow"))` other subjects. Keyness is computed with the
true corpus sizes: `{python} num(mian.get("slowa_cel"))` words of biology, `{python} num(mian.get("slowa_kontrast"))`
words of contrast, `{python} num(int(mian.get("kwjp_suma_listy") or 0))` words behind the KWJP100 list. For a
multiword candidate PMI and logDice are computed for each pair of adjacent words and the lowest value is kept, so a
phrase scores high only if every link in it is strong.

### How much of the silver standard is reachable

```{python}
cov = m42.get("srebrny_pokrycie", {})
lab = {"slowniczek": "Glossary entries", "pojecie_ref": "Editors' base forms of linked terms"}
L.table([(lab.get(k, k), d.get("hasla"), d.get("hasla_wielowyrazowe"), d.get("wydobyte_z_korpusu_docelowego"),
          d.get("wsrod_kandydatow_po_progach"), d.get("wsrod_kandydatow_po_progach_wielowyrazowe"), pct(d.get("udzial_wsrod_kandydatow")))
         for k, d in cov.items()],
        ["Silver standard (target materials)", "Entries", "… multiword", "Found in the corpus by the extraction",
         "Among candidates after the thresholds", "… multiword", "Share among candidates"])
```

The last column is the ceiling for recall of any ranking: an entry that is not a candidate cannot be ranked. Entries
are lost mostly to the frequency thresholds, which matter more on a small sample.

### Precision and recall at K against the silver standards

Each method ranks the candidates it can score; P@K is the share of its top K that is in the silver standard, R@K the
share of the silver items among the candidates that it has reached by K. The *baseline* row is the share of silver
items among all candidates, which is what a random ranking would achieve.

```{python}
prec, base = m42.get("precyzja_wzgledem_srebrnego", {}), m42.get("precyzja_poziom_odniesienia", {})
mlab = {"ll_kontrast": "log-likelihood vs contrast", "log_ratio_kontrast": "log ratio vs contrast",
        "simple_maths_kwjp": "Simple Maths vs KWJP100", "ll_kwjp": "log-likelihood vs KWJP100", "tfidf_biol": "TF-IDF across subjects",
        "pmi_mwu": "PMI (multiword)", "logdice_mwu": "logDice (multiword)", "cvalue_termopl": "TermoPL C-value",
        "rrf": "reciprocal-rank fusion of the methods", "frekwencja_cel": "frequency in biology alone"}
univ = {"wszystkie": "All candidates", "jednowyrazowe": "Single words", "wielowyrazowe": "Multiword"}
parts = ["::: {.panel-tabset}"]
for u, title in univ.items():
    rows = [("*baseline: random ranking*", "", *[base.get(u, {}).get("vs_union")] * 3, "", "", "")]
    for m, d in prec.items():
        v = (d.get(u) or {}).get("vs_union")
        if v:
            rows.append((mlab.get(m, m), v.get("n_ranking"), *[v.get(f"{x}@{k}") for x in "pr" for k in (100, 300, 1000)]))
    parts += [f"#### {title}", L.table_md(rows, ["Method", "Candidates ranked", "P@100", "P@300", "P@1000", "R@100", "R@300", "R@1000"])]
L.md("\n\n".join(parts + [":::"]))
```

Both silver standards are taken together here; the figures for each one separately are in the raw metrics file. The
silver standard only contains what ZPE editors chose to explain, so low precision does not mean the top candidates
are wrong. It supports comparison between methods only.

```{python}
mv = m5.get("metody_wzgledem_etykiet_llm", {})
if mv:
    L.md("### The same rankings against the final labels of step 5\n\nShare of the top K that the models finally "
         "labelled **T3**. The labels come from language models, not from people, so this is a second imperfect "
         "yardstick, but unlike the glossaries it covers every candidate.")
    parts = ["::: {.panel-tabset}"]
    for u, title in univ.items():
        rows = [("*baseline: share of T3 among candidates*", "", "", *[mv.get("poziom_odniesienia", {}).get(u)] * 3, "", "", "")]
        for m, d in mv.items():
            v = d.get(u) if m != "poziom_odniesienia" else None
            if v:
                rows.append((mlab.get(m, m), v.get("n_ranking"), v.get("n_T3"), *[v.get(f"{x}@{k}") for x in "pr" for k in (100, 300, 1000)]))
        parts += [f"#### {title}", L.table_md(rows, ["Method", "Candidates ranked", "T3 among them", "P@100", "P@300", "P@1000", "R@100", "R@300", "R@1000"])]
    L.md("\n\n".join(parts + [":::"]))
```

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Precision at 300 of each ranking against the final T3 label, all candidates."
#| fig-alt: "Horizontal bar chart of precision at 300 by extraction method, with the baseline share of T3 as a vertical line."
rows = sorted(((mlab.get(m, m), (d.get("wszystkie") or {}).get("p@300")) for m, d in mv.items() if m != "poziom_odniesienia"),
              key=lambda x: x[1] or 0)
rows = [r for r in rows if r[1] is not None]
if rows:
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.4, 0.32 * len(rows) + 1))
    bars = ax.barh([r[0] for r in rows], [r[1] for r in rows], color=INK)
    ax.bar_label(bars, fmt="%.2f", padding=3)
    b0 = mv.get("poziom_odniesienia", {}).get("wszystkie")
    if b0:
        ax.axvline(b0, color=ACCENT, lw=1.5); ax.text(b0, len(rows) - 0.4, " share of T3", color=ACCENT, va="bottom", fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1); ax.set_xlabel("P@300 against the final T3 label")
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```

## 5 · LLM classification {#llm}

```{python}
mod, ag = m5.get("modele", {}), m5.get("zgodnosc_miedzy_modelami", {})
a_name, b_name = (short(x) for x in (mod.get("porownywane") or ["–", "–"])[:2])
judge = short(mod.get("rozstrzygajacy"))
```

Two models, **`{python} a_name`** and **`{python} b_name`**, label every candidate independently. Each sees the
candidate, its counts in biology and in the other subjects, and up to three sentences from the corpus; neither sees
the rule-based pre-label or the other model's answer. Where the two labels differ, or either model reports low
confidence, **`{python} judge`** labels the candidate as well and the majority of the three decides. If all three
differ, the adjudicator's label is used and the row is marked for review.

```{python}
rows = [("Candidates labelled", m5.get("n_klasyfikowanych")), ("… subject candidates", m5.get("n_klasyfikowanych_przedmiotowych")),
        ("… general candidates only (stratified sample)", m5.get("n_klasyfikowanych_ogolnych")),
        (f"Agreement between {a_name} and {b_name}", ag.get("prosta")), ("Cohen's κ", ag.get("kappa")),
        ("Adjudicated", m5.get("n_rozstrzyganych")), ("Left for review after adjudication", m5.get("n_do_przegladu")),
        ("Base forms corrected by the models", m5.get("n_form_poprawionych")), ("Prompt version", m5.get("wersja_promptu")),
        ("Wall-clock time of the step", f"{num(m5.get('czas_s'))} s")]
L.table(rows, ["Measure", "Value"])
```

::: {.callout-warning title="Agreement is not accuracy"}
There are no human labels yet. The worksheet for double annotation is on the
[Annotation worksheets](sheets.qmd) page; once it is filled in, step 6 reports precision, recall and F1 of the
final labels against people.
:::

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Final labels

```{python}
cat = {"T3": "T3 · biology term", "T3_INNY": "T3_INNY · term of another subject", "T2": "T2 · school / academic vocabulary",
       "T1": "T1 · everyday vocabulary", "SZUM": "SZUM · not usable as a test item"}
fa, fs, fg = (m5.get(k, {}) for k in ("rozklad_final", "rozklad_final_przedmiotowe", "rozklad_final_tylko_ogolne"))
L.table([(cat[k], fa.get(k, 0), fs.get(k, 0), fg.get(k, 0)) for k in cat], ["Final label", "All", "Subject candidates", "General candidates only"])
noise = {"fragment_terminu": "part of a longer term", "luzne_polaczenie": "free word combination", "nazwa_wlasna": "proper name",
         "blad_ekstrakcji": "extraction error", "interfejs": "platform interface or instruction text", "inne": "other",
         "brak": "not specified"}
L.md("Kinds of noise:")
L.table([(noise.get(k, k), v) for k, v in m5.get("typy_szumu", {}).items()], ["Kind", "Candidates"])
```

#### Agreement by group

```{python}
seg = {"wszystkie": "all", "przedmiotowe": "subject candidates", "tylko_ogolne": "general candidates only",
       "jednowyrazowe": "single words", "wielowyrazowe": "multiword"}
L.table([(seg.get(k, k), d.get("n"), d.get("prosta"), d.get("kappa")) for k, d in ag.get("wg_segmentu", {}).items()],
        ["Candidates", "n", "Agreement", "Cohen's κ"])
vf = m5.get("zgodnosc_z_etykieta_koncowa", {})
L.md("Agreement of each model with the final label:")
```

#### Model against model

```{python}
mp = m5.get("macierz_pomylek", {})
data, order = mp.get("dane", {}), list(cat)
cols = [c for c in order if c in data]
rows = [(r, *[data.get(c, {}).get(r, 0) for c in cols]) for r in order if any(r in data.get(c, {}) for c in cols)]
L.table(rows, [f"{mp.get('wiersze', '').replace('_', ' ')} ↓ / {mp.get('kolumny', '').replace('_', ' ')} →", *cols])
```

#### Adjudication

```{python}
js = m5.get("rozstrzygniecia", {})
rows = [("Cases sent to the adjudicator", js.get("n")), ("… because the two labels differed", js.get("powod_rozbieznosc_etykiet")),
        ("… labels agreed, but a model reported low confidence", js.get("powod_niska_pewnosc_przy_zgodzie"))]
rows += [(f"Adjudicator chose the label of {k.replace('_', ' ')}", v) for k, v in js.get("zgodny_z", {}).items()]
rows += [("Adjudicator chose a third label", js.get("inny_niz_oba"))]
L.table(rows, ["Measure", "Cases"])
L.md("Where the two models agreed with each other, the adjudicator's agreement is counted for both.")
```

### Direct extraction by a language model

```{python}
ex = m5.get("ekstrakcja_llm", {})
if ex.get("n_terminow"):
    L.md(f"As an independent check of step 4, {short(ex.get('model'))} read {num(ex.get('n_materialow'))} biology materials "
         "and listed the terms in them. The table shows how many of those terms the statistical extraction had also found.")
    L.table([("Distinct terms listed", ex.get("n_terminow")), ("… labelled as biology terms (T3)", ex.get("n_terminow_T3")),
             ("… … multiword", ex.get("n_terminow_T3_wielowyrazowych")),
             ("Share of those T3 terms that are candidates of step 4", pct(ex.get("T3_wsrod_kandydatow"))),
             ("… single words", pct(ex.get("T3_jednowyrazowe_wsrod_kandydatow"))),
             ("… multiword", pct(ex.get("T3_wielowyrazowe_wsrod_kandydatow"))),
             ("Share that also carry the final label T3", pct(ex.get("T3_z_etykieta_koncowa_T3")))], ["Measure", "Value"])
    L.md("The terms that are not candidates are listed on the [Pools](pools.qmd) page. On a sample, most are missing "
         "because they occur fewer times than the frequency threshold.")
else:
    L.md("Not run.")
```

### Cost

```{python}
# stan księgi kosztów zapisany przez krok raportu (obejmuje też żądania wysłane po kroku 5, np. pseudosłowa)
m8k = L.metrics("koszty_8") or {"wg_zadania": m5.get("koszty_usd_wg_zadania", {}), "przebieg": m5.get("koszt_usd_przebieg"),
                                "dotychczas": m5.get("koszt_usd_dotychczas")}
costs = m8k.get("wg_zadania") or {}
L.table([(k.split(" / ")[0], short(k.split(" / ")[-1]), f"{v:.2f}") for k, v in costs.items()], ["Task", "Model", "USD"], "llr")
L.md(f"All API tasks of the pipeline are listed, not only step 5: the lemmatisation benchmark (step 2), classification, "
     f"direct extraction and concepts (step 5), pseudoword generation and rating (step 7), and test requests. "
     f"Sum for this run: **{m8k.get('przebieg') or 0:.2f} USD**; for all runs of this configuration so far: "
     f"**{m8k.get('dotychczas') or 0:.2f} USD**. Tasks of earlier prompt versions are included. Requests go through "
     "the Batch API with prompt caching; the limit set in the configuration is "
     f"{cfg['llm']['limit_kosztu_usd']} USD.")
```

### Matching the general pool to the subject pool

```{python}
L.table([("Subject terms", dp.get("n_terminow")), ("… with a matched general item", dp.get("n_dopasowanych")),
         ("Share matched", pct(dp.get("udzial_dopasowanych"))),
         ("Mean absolute difference in Zipf frequency within pairs", dp.get("srednia_abs_delta_zipf")),
         ("Mean absolute difference in letters within pairs", dp.get("srednia_abs_delta_liter"))], ["Measure", "Value"])
L.md("Balance: standardised mean difference between subject terms and general items, before matching (whole pools) "
     "and after (pairs only). Values near 0 mean the two groups do not differ on that feature.")
L.table([("Zipf frequency", dp.get("smd_zipf_przed"), dp.get("smd_zipf_po")), ("Length in letters", dp.get("smd_liter_przed"), dp.get("smd_liter_po"))],
        ["Feature", "Before matching", "After matching"])
st = {"rzeczownik": "nouns", "przymiotnik": "adjectives", "czasownik": "verbs", "przysłówek": "adverbs", "inne": "other single words",
      "fraza 2": "two-word phrases", "fraza 3": "phrases of three or more words"}
L.table([(st.get(k, k), d.get("terminy"), d.get("pula_ogolna"), d.get("dopasowane"), pct(d.get("udzial")))
         for k, d in sorted(dp.get("wg_warstwy", {}).items(), key=lambda x: -x[1].get("terminy", 0))],
        ["Stratum", "Subject terms", "General items available", "Matched", "Share"])
```

Subject terms are on average rarer in general Polish than everyday and school words, so not every term can have a
partner within the calipers; unmatched terms stay in the pool with an empty `dopasowanie_ogolne`.

```{python}
rows = [(f"`{m}`", d.get("wygenerowane"), d.get("przyjete"), pct(d.get("udzial_przyjetych")), d.get("oceniane"), pct(d.get("udzial_pozytywnych")),
         d.get("srednia_wymawialnosc"), d.get("srednie_podobienstwo"), d.get("srednie_old20"), d.get("wybrane")) for m, d in m7.get("wg_metody", {}).items()]
L.table(rows, ["Generator", "Generated", "Passed the filters", "… share", "Rated", "Rated positively", "Pronounceability (1–5)",
```

#### Rejection reasons

```{python}
why = {"znaki_spoza_alfabetu": "characters outside the alphabet", "istniejace_slowo": "existing word",
       "ksztalt_niezgodny_ze_wzorcem": "length, syllables or ending differ from the template",
       "za_blisko_wzorca": "one letter from the template", "ortotaktyka": "untypical letter pattern",
       "literowka_czestego_slowa": "one edit from a frequent word", "homofon": "sounds like an existing word",
       "przejrzysta_budowa": "existing stem with an affix, or a compound", "skojarzenie_wulgarne": "vulgar association",
       "slowo_ukrainskie_lub_rosyjskie": "Ukrainian or Russian word"}
reasons = list(m7.get("odrzucenia_powody", {}))
meths = list(m7.get("wg_metody", {}))
L.table([(why.get(r, r), m7["odrzucenia_powody"][r], *[m7["wg_metody"][m].get("powody", {}).get(r, 0) for m in meths]) for r in reasons],
        ["Reason (first filter failed)", "All", *[f"`{m}`" for m in meths]])
```

#### Templates against pseudowords

```{python}
ro = m7.get("rozklady", [])
feat = {"dlugosc": "Length in letters", "syl": "Syllables", "zbitka": "Longest consonant run", "diakryty": "Diacritic letters",
        "old20": "OLD20", "bigram_lp": "Mean log bigram probability"}
g = {(r["grupa"], r["cecha"]): r for r in ro} if isinstance(ro, list) else {}
rows = [(f, g.get(("szablony", k), {}).get("srednia"), g.get(("pseudoslowa_przyjete", k), {}).get("srednia"),
         g.get(("pseudoslowa_przyjete", k), {}).get("smd_wzgledem_szablonow"), g.get(("pseudoslowa_wybrane", k), {}).get("srednia"),
         g.get(("pseudoslowa_wybrane", k), {}).get("smd_wzgledem_szablonow")) for k, f in feat.items()]
L.table(rows, ["Feature", "Templates, mean", "Passed the filters, mean", "… standardised difference", "Recommended, mean", "… standardised difference"])
```
